steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cf_edit_commit (commit_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,session_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,provider VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,owner_user_id VARCHAR(225) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,device_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,device_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,session_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,store_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,snapshot LONGTEXT COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,upload_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,upload_bytes BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,state VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,new_file_id CHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,published_head CHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY session_commit(session_id),KEY owner_commits(provider,owner_user_id,commit_id),KEY pending(state,updated_at,commit_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
